description: Fix Vite 7 configuration issues causing browser page not to load. The vite.config.js has three problems: (1) an invalid top-level 'oxc' config key that does nothing in Vite 7.3.3, (2) an invalid 'optimizeDeps.rolldownOptions' key (should be removed - Vite 7 does not have this config), and (3) potential conflict between the oxc config and the react() plugin for JSX handling. These misconfigurations cause Vite 7's dev server to fail to properly transform .js files containing JSX during dependency pre-bundling and module serving, resulting in runtime errors that prevent React from mounting.
steps: In apps/frontend/vite.config.js, REMOVE the entire top-level 'oxc' config block (lines ~596-605 inside defineConfig). This block is not a valid Vite 7 configuration option and its settings are already handled by the react() plugin. The block looks like: oxc: { include: /\.(m?[jt]sx?)$/, exclude: /node_modules/, lang: 'jsx', jsx: { runtime: 'automatic', importSource: 'react' } }

In apps/frontend/vite.config.js, inside the 'optimizeDeps' section, REMOVE the 'rolldownOptions' key and its value: rolldownOptions: { moduleTypes: { '.js': 'jsx' } }. This key does not exist in Vite 7's DepOptimizationConfig and is silently ignored. The JSX transform for source files is handled by the react() plugin and the esbuild config.
Verify the react() plugin configuration still has include: /\.(js|jsx|ts|tsx)$/ - this is what tells the plugin to handle JSX in .js files.
Verify the esbuild config still has target: 'esnext' and the jsx-related settings are NOT overridden (the react plugin handles this).
Run the build (pnpm --filter @workspace/syrabit run build:client) to confirm it still succeeds.
Run vitest (pnpm --filter @workspace/syrabit exec vitest run) to confirm tests still pass.
acceptance_criteria: The vite.config.js no longer contains the invalid 'oxc' top-level key
The vite.config.js no longer contains 'rolldownOptions' inside optimizeDeps
The client build (vite build) completes successfully
The dev server starts without errors and serves the index.html and transformed JSX source files correctly
findings: Build succeeds (17.93s). 622/623 tests pass; 1 timing-based test (latency-comparison.test.js - X-API-Version Header Overhead) is flaky under load and fails intermittently when all 67 test files run concurrently but passes in isolation on both base and patched code.
